## Research question & project scope

I contributed to developing and sharpening our research question on the relationship between German macroeconomic conditions and support for the AfD.

## Exploratory data analysis

I worked on the exploratory analysis. Interpreting the plot, I identified and described the distinct phases in AfD polling — the 2017 decline and recovery, the 2018–2020 stagnation, the drop during COVID, the steep increase across 2022 and 2023, the 2024 decline, and the slower but near-continuous growth since.

## Analysis write-up

My main individual responsibility was turning our analytical results into written findings. I drafted the findings section, structuring it as a description of AfD polling dynamics on their own, followed by the relationship with real GDP growth over time. The central substantive point I argued for was that the link between a weak economy and stronger AfD support appears more pronounced after COVID than before it, so the party did not benefit from the weak economy in that phase.
